basis: Source-evaluated canonical Tool declarations plus registry annotations; NOT a running tools/list snapshot.

session_project.purpose: Connect or disconnect, open an existing project, create a new project, inspect it, save it, or close it.

project_context.purpose: Inspect the active project, inspect its tree, save changes, and export structure views while working in another capability.

parameters.purpose: Create, inspect, and change design parameters without loading sweeps or optimizers.

materials_basic.purpose: Define ordinary dielectric and metallic materials, load native library entries, and assign materials.

geometry_basic.purpose: Build common solid primitives and wires for substrates, conductors, probes, dipoles, and simple supports.

geometry_profiles.purpose: Build profile-based and less frequent shapes without loading their schemas during ordinary brick/cylinder work.

solid_operations.purpose: Combine solids and translate, rotate, mirror, scale, or copy geometry where the native tool supports it.

simulation_domain.purpose: Configure the frequency band, boundary conditions, background, and compatible symmetry.

ports_basic.purpose: Create common waveguide/discrete ports and lumped elements, inspect ports, and remove a specified port.

solver_time_domain.purpose: Configure the time-domain solver and inspect the solver configuration.

solver_frequency_domain.purpose: Configure the frequency-domain solver and inspect the solver configuration.

mesh_basic.purpose: Configure the solver-compatible mesh, density, local refinement, and supported adaptation.

field_monitors.purpose: Define the field monitors needed by the intended analysis before a solve.

simulation_run.purpose: Start a solve asynchronously, inspect progress, wait for bounded periods, or stop a run.

diagnostics.purpose: Read project logs, check a described setup, or explicitly invalidate existing results when required by a change.

dialog_recovery.purpose: Recover from a known modal-dialog obstruction and manage the optional broad dialog watcher.

reference.purpose: Read the installed official CST documentation when a tool contract or CST operation is unfamiliar.

cad_io.purpose: Import existing CAD geometry or export model geometry.

connectors.purpose: Add the specific supported parametric edge-launch SMA connector when its assumptions match the model.

cst_search_help.name: cst_search_help
cst_search_help.description: Full-text search of the installed official CST Python/VBA help (offline; does not start CST). Every query word must appear in the topic's file name, title or page text (AND semantics, case-insensitive substring), so multi-word queries such as 'Polygon ExtrudeCurve' and in-page method names such as 'AddPotentialNumerically' are found. Title/file-name hits rank above body-only hits; each result carries a text snippet around the match. The index is built once (cached in memory and under the work dir). Read the matching help with cst_read_help before constructing API calls.

cst_read_help.name: cst_read_help
cst_read_help.description: Read a paginated official local CST help topic returned by cst_search_help. No GUI or solver.

cst_connect.name: cst_connect
cst_connect.description: Explicitly attach to a CST Design Environment (DE). Disabled mode never connects. mode='any' (default) uses connect_to_any_or_new(): it attaches to ANY running DE, including one the user opened interactively (and adopts its active project), or starts a new DE when none is running. mode='new' always starts a fresh DE via DesignEnvironment.new() and never touches an existing DE or its projects; prefer it for unattended/batch work while the user may have CST open. The response reports de_pid, newly_started, running_des_before and open_project_paths so you can see what was attached; a 'warning' is added when the DE may be a pre-existing (user) session.

mode.description: 'any' = attach to any running DE or start one; 'new' = always start a fresh DE.

cst_disconnect.name: cst_disconnect
cst_disconnect.description: Detach this MCP session without closing CST, projects, or a running solver.

cst_create_project.name: cst_create_project
cst_create_project.description: Create a new CST Studio Suite project file. In connected mode the project is created directly; in offline mode a VBA script is returned for manual execution.

path.description: Full file path for the new project, e.g. 'C:/cst_projects/MyAntenna.cst'.

project_type.description: CST project type. One of: MWS (Microwave Studio), EMS (EM Studio), PS (Particle Studio), MPS (Mphysics Studio), CS (Cable Studio), DS (Design Studio), PCB (PCB Studio).

cst_open_project.name: cst_open_project
cst_open_project.description: Open an existing CST Studio Suite project. In connected mode the project is opened in the running instance; in offline mode a reference is stored for subsequent operations.

path.description: Full file path of the existing .cst project to open.

cst_save_project.name: cst_save_project
cst_save_project.description: Save the currently open CST project. Optionally provide a new path to 'Save As'.

cst_close_project.name: cst_close_project
cst_close_project.description: Close the currently open CST project and release its resources.

cst_project_info.name: cst_project_info
cst_project_info.description: Get information about the currently open CST project, including connection mode, project path, and status.

cst_project_tree.name: cst_project_tree
cst_project_tree.description: List items in the CST project navigation tree. Optionally specify a subtree path such as 'Components', 'Materials', 'Ports', 'Monitors', or 'Results'.

tree_path.description: Navigation tree path to list, e.g. 'Components', 'Results', or '2D/3D Results'. Omit for the root tree.

max_depth.description: How many levels below tree_path to enumerate (default 3).

cst_connection_status.name: cst_connection_status
cst_connection_status.description: Get the current CST Studio connection status, including mode (connected/offline), CST availability, version, and work directory.

cst_create_brick.name: cst_create_brick
cst_create_brick.description: Create a rectangular brick (box) in CST Studio. Bounds accept JSON numbers or nonempty, single-line CST parameter names/arithmetic expressions, mixed in the same call. Expressions remain in model history for parameter rebuilds; CST validates their syntax and parameter references. Does not edit existing solids.

x_min.description: X range minimum: finite JSON number or nonempty single-line CST parameter/arithmetic expression (e.g. 'PBrick_L', '200+PBrick_L', 'PBrick_H/2'); preserved in model history. CST reports malformed expressions or undefined parameters.

x_max.description: X range maximum: finite JSON number or nonempty single-line CST parameter/arithmetic expression (e.g. 'PBrick_L', '200+PBrick_L', 'PBrick_H/2'); preserved in model history. CST reports malformed expressions or undefined parameters.

y_min.description: Y range minimum: finite JSON number or nonempty single-line CST parameter/arithmetic expression (e.g. 'PBrick_L', '200+PBrick_L', 'PBrick_H/2'); preserved in model history. CST reports malformed expressions or undefined parameters.

y_max.description: Y range maximum: finite JSON number or nonempty single-line CST parameter/arithmetic expression (e.g. 'PBrick_L', '200+PBrick_L', 'PBrick_H/2'); preserved in model history. CST reports malformed expressions or undefined parameters.

z_min.description: Z range minimum: finite JSON number or nonempty single-line CST parameter/arithmetic expression (e.g. 'PBrick_L', '200+PBrick_L', 'PBrick_H/2'); preserved in model history. CST reports malformed expressions or undefined parameters.

z_max.description: Z range maximum: finite JSON number or nonempty single-line CST parameter/arithmetic expression (e.g. 'PBrick_L', '200+PBrick_L', 'PBrick_H/2'); preserved in model history. CST reports malformed expressions or undefined parameters.

cst_create_cylinder.description: Create a cylinder in CST Studio. Use inner_radius=0 for a solid cylinder.

cst_create_cone.description: Create a cone or truncated cone in CST Studio.

cst_create_extrude.name: cst_create_extrude
cst_create_extrude.description: Extrude a 2D polygon profile into a 3D solid in CST Studio (Extrude object, Mode 'pointlist'). The profile lies in the plane normal to 'axis' (default z) at the given x/y/z_offset. Height, profile coordinates and the active offset accept numbers or single-line CST expressions preserved in history. Double arguments use native Evaluate. Only the selected-axis offset applies. Optional 'holes' are extruded the same way and subtracted (Solid.Subtract). Live CST validation is pending.

items.description: Profile coordinate: finite JSON number or nonempty single-line CST expression; preserved in model history. CST reports semantic expression errors.

points.description: List of [x, y] coordinate pairs forming the profile polygon

height.description: Extrusion height: finite JSON number or nonempty single-line CST expression; preserved in model history. CST reports semantic expression errors.

axis.description: Extrusion axis (profile plane normal). z: (u,v)=(x,y); x: (u,v)=(y,z); y: (u,v)=(x,-z).

x_offset.description: Base-plane position on x; expressions allowed only with axis='x': finite JSON number or nonempty single-line CST expression; preserved in model history. CST reports semantic expression errors.

y_offset.description: Base-plane position on y; expressions allowed only with axis='y': finite JSON number or nonempty single-line CST expression; preserved in model history. CST reports semantic expression errors.

z_offset.description: Base-plane position on z; expressions allowed only with axis='z': finite JSON number or nonempty single-line CST expression; preserved in model history. CST reports semantic expression errors.

items.description: Profile coordinate: finite JSON number or nonempty single-line CST expression; preserved in model history. CST reports semantic expression errors.

holes.description: Optional holes/slots: each a list of [x, y] pairs in the same profile plane. Each hole is extruded with the same height and removed with Solid.Subtract.

extrude_direction.description: 'up' (default, unchanged behaviour): solid spans offset..offset+height along +axis (e.g. copper on top of a substrate whose top face is z=offset). 'down': offset-height..offset. Pointlist down reverses the plane normal and remaps local coordinates, correcting the previously ignored option.

cst_create_loft.name: cst_create_loft
cst_create_loft.description: Create a capped solid with LoftCurves between two or more explicit 3D polygon profiles. Coordinates accept finite JSON numbers or nonempty single-line CST expressions, preserved for parameter rebuilds. Legacy [x, y] points are rejected; supply [x, y, z] without inferred spacing. CST validates expressions and geometry.

items.description: Profile coordinate: finite JSON number or nonempty single-line CST expression; preserved in model history. CST reports semantic expression errors.

profiles.description: At least two profiles of explicit [x, y, z] vertices, each coordinate a finite JSON number or nonempty single-line CST expression. Vertex order is preserved; an optional repeated endpoint is removed before closing exactly once. At least three vertices must remain. Separate auxiliary curve groups are created; existing groups are not adopted or deleted. No path or inferred z coordinates.

cst_create_wire.name: cst_create_wire
cst_create_wire.description: Create a bondwire / wire between two points in CST Studio.

cst_create_polygon3d.description: Create a 3D polygon curve in CST Studio.

items.description: Point coordinate: finite JSON number or nonempty single-line CST expression; preserved in model history. CST reports semantic expression errors.

points.description: List of [x, y, z] coordinate triples

cst_create_analytical_curve.name: cst_create_analytical_curve
cst_create_analytical_curve.description: Create a parametric analytical curve in CST Studio using expressions of parameter t. t_min and t_max accept finite numbers or CST expressions preserved in model history.

x_expr.description: X expression as function of t (e.g. 'cos(t)')

y_expr.description: Y expression as function of t (e.g. 'sin(t)')

z_expr.description: Z expression as function of t (e.g. 't')

cst_create_face_from_curves.description: Create a planar sheet consisting of one face from exactly one qualified closed planar curve reference (curvegroup:curveitem) in CST Studio. CST reports native geometric errors. Connected curve items may be included by CST.

curve_names.description: Exactly one qualified curve reference, e.g. 'Curves:Rectangle'. Independent profile lists are unsupported; the curve must be closed and planar.

cst_create_ecylinder.name: cst_create_ecylinder
cst_create_ecylinder.description: Create an elliptical cylinder in CST Studio.

x_radius.description: Radius in local X direction: finite JSON number or nonempty single-line CST expression; preserved in model history. CST reports semantic expression errors.

y_radius.description: Radius in local Y direction: finite JSON number or nonempty single-line CST expression; preserved in model history. CST reports semantic expression errors.

center_x.description: Center X coordinate: finite JSON number or nonempty single-line CST expression; preserved in model history. CST reports semantic expression errors.

center_y.description: Center Y coordinate: finite JSON number or nonempty single-line CST expression; preserved in model history. CST reports semantic expression errors.

center_z.description: Center Z coordinate: finite JSON number or nonempty single-line CST expression; preserved in model history. CST reports semantic expression errors.

range_min.description: Axis range minimum: finite JSON number or nonempty single-line CST expression; preserved in model history. CST reports semantic expression errors.

range_max.description: Axis range maximum: finite JSON number or nonempty single-line CST expression; preserved in model history. CST reports semantic expression errors.

cst_create_polygon_extrude.name: cst_create_polygon_extrude
cst_create_polygon_extrude.description: Create a polygon and extrude it along an axis in CST Studio. Convenience tool combining polygon profile creation (Polygon3D curve) and extrusion (ExtrudeCurve). The profile lies at the base plane given by x/y/z_offset for the chosen axis; optional 'holes' (lists of [x, y]) are extruded the same way and removed with Solid.Subtract, e.g. for slotted/fractal patches. Z placement: CST's ExtrudeCurve extrudes along the closed curve's normal, which follows the point winding (a clockwise profile at z=0 with positive thickness lands at z=-t..0, e.g. copper embedded in the substrate). This tool normalises the winding, so extrude_direction='up' (default) gives offset..offset+height along +axis and 'down' gives offset-height..offset; the response reports input-contract endpoints, not measured bounds. Height, all profile coordinates and the active offset accept numbers or single-line CST expressions. Native Evaluate and winding selection remain in history for reconstruction. Live CST validation is pending; native dialogs may show evaluated values.

items.description: Profile coordinate: finite JSON number or nonempty single-line CST expression; preserved in model history. CST reports semantic expression errors.

points.description: List of [x, y] coordinate pairs forming the polygon

height.description: Extrusion height: finite JSON number or nonempty single-line CST expression; preserved in model history. CST reports semantic expression errors.

x_offset.description: Base-plane position on x; expressions allowed only with axis='x': finite JSON number or nonempty single-line CST expression; preserved in model history. CST reports semantic expression errors.

y_offset.description: Base-plane position on y; expressions allowed only with axis='y': finite JSON number or nonempty single-line CST expression; preserved in model history. CST reports semantic expression errors.

z_offset.description: Base-plane position on z; expressions allowed only with axis='z': finite JSON number or nonempty single-line CST expression; preserved in model history. CST reports semantic expression errors.

items.description: Profile coordinate: finite JSON number or nonempty single-line CST expression; preserved in model history. CST reports semantic expression errors.

holes.description: Optional holes/slots: each a list of [x, y] pairs in the same profile plane. Each hole is extruded with the same height and removed with Solid.Subtract.

extrude_direction.description: 'up' (default, unchanged behaviour): solid spans offset..offset+height along +axis (e.g. copper on top of a substrate whose top face is z=offset). 'down': offset-height..offset. Numeric winding is normalized before generation; symbolic winding is evaluated independently for each profile on every rebuild.

cst_boolean_add.name: cst_boolean_add
cst_boolean_add.description: Unite/add two solids together. The result replaces solid1 with the combined volume of both shapes.

cst_boolean_subtract.name: cst_boolean_subtract

cst_boolean_intersect.name: cst_boolean_intersect
cst_boolean_intersect.description: Intersect two solids. Only the overlapping volume is kept, replacing solid1. Solid2 is deleted.

cst_boolean_insert.name: cst_boolean_insert
cst_boolean_insert.description: Insert solid2 into solid1. Solid2 is embedded within solid1, maintaining both material regions at the overlap.

cst_transform_mirror.description: Mirror a solid across a plane (xy, xz, or yz). An optional center point can be specified.

copy.description: If true, create a copy instead of moving the original

cst_create_material.name: cst_create_material
cst_create_material.description: Create a new material with electromagnetic properties in CST Studio. Specify relative permittivity (epsilon), relative permeability (mu), electric and magnetic loss tangents, and conductivity.

cst_create_lossy_metal.name: cst_create_lossy_metal
cst_create_lossy_metal.description: Create a lossy metal material in CST Studio. Lossy metals model finite conductivity skin-effect losses, essential for accurate loss calculations in connectors, waveguides, and PCB traces.

conductivity.description: Electric conductivity in S/m (e.g. 5.8e7 for copper)

cst_load_material.name: cst_load_material
cst_load_material.description: Load a native CST .mtd material definition and all its properties under the given project name. Uses CST_PATH/Library/Materials by default, or the directory supplied as library_path.

name.description: Name for the material in the project

library_path.description: Directory containing native .mtd material files. Overrides the configured CST installation's Library/Materials directory.

cst_list_materials.name: cst_list_materials
cst_list_materials.description: List available materials from the bundled material database. Optionally filter by category: 'metals', 'dielectrics', or 'substrates'. Returns name, key EM properties, and usage notes for each material.

cst_assign_material.name: cst_assign_material
cst_assign_material.description: Assign a material to an existing solid in CST Studio. The solid is specified as 'Component:SolidName'.

cst_get_material_info.name: cst_get_material_info
cst_get_material_info.description: Get electromagnetic properties of a material from the bundled database. Returns epsilon_r, mu_r, conductivity, loss tangent, and usage notes.

cst_add_waveguide_port.name: cst_add_waveguide_port
cst_add_waveguide_port.description: Add a waveguide port for S-parameter excitation. Defines a port face on the boundary of the simulation domain by default. Set port_on_bound=False to preserve the supplied normal coordinate for an internal port. IMPORTANT: The port plane should be at or near the edge of the model geometry. Ground planes and substrates must NOT extend past the port plane in the port's orientation direction, or VBA execution may hang. For microstrip feeds: place the port at the end of the feed line where the ground/substrate terminates. Use Coordinates='Free' for ports not aligned to the bounding box. Valid orientations: xmin/xmax/ymin/ymax/zmin/zmax.

orientation.description: Port orientation and excitation direction, also valid for internal ports

x_min.description: X-axis minimum coordinate of the port aperture (mm)

x_max.description: X-axis maximum coordinate of the port aperture (mm)

y_min.description: Y-axis minimum coordinate of the port aperture (mm)

y_max.description: Y-axis maximum coordinate of the port aperture (mm)

z_min.description: Z-axis minimum coordinate of the port aperture (mm)

z_max.description: Z-axis maximum coordinate of the port aperture (mm)

mode_number.description: Number of calculated modes (default 1), not a mode-index selector

coordinates.description: Coordinate mode. 'Free' allows arbitrary placement using the specified ranges (required for microstrip/coplanar ports). 'Full' maps the port to the full bounding-box face. 'Picks' uses previously picked geometry faces. Default: 'Free'.

port_on_bound.description: Place the port on the domain boundary by default. False preserves the explicitly supplied normal coordinate inside the domain. CST ignores this setting for picked ports.

cst_add_discrete_port.name: cst_add_discrete_port
cst_add_discrete_port.description: Add a discrete (lumped) port between two points. Used for circuit-level excitation with a defined impedance.

x1.description: X coordinate of the start point (mm)

y1.description: Y coordinate of the start point (mm)

z1.description: Z coordinate of the start point (mm)

x2.description: X coordinate of the end point (mm)

y2.description: Y coordinate of the end point (mm)

z2.description: Z coordinate of the end point (mm)

cst_add_lumped_element.name: cst_add_lumped_element
cst_add_lumped_element.description: Add a lumped R, L, C, or RLC element between two points. Value is in ohms for R, henries for L, farads for C.

name.description: Unique name for the lumped element

value.description: Element value (ohms for R, henries for L, farads for C)

x1.description: X coordinate of the first terminal (mm)

y1.description: Y coordinate of the first terminal (mm)

z1.description: Z coordinate of the first terminal (mm)

x2.description: X coordinate of the second terminal (mm)

y2.description: Y coordinate of the second terminal (mm)

z2.description: Z coordinate of the second terminal (mm)

cst_list_ports.name: cst_list_ports
cst_list_ports.description: List all ports defined in the current CST project. Returns VBA to query port information, or a description in offline mode.

cst_delete_port.name: cst_delete_port
cst_delete_port.description: Delete a port by its port number.

cst_set_boundary.name: cst_set_boundary
cst_set_boundary.description: Set boundary conditions for the simulation domain. Each face of the bounding box can be assigned an independent boundary type (open, electric, magnetic, periodic, etc.). Note: 'open' adds no space, and CST extends geometry touching an open boundary into the PML (virtually infinite); a waveguide port on such a face with the board ending there leaks power into the PML (efficiency/gain unreliable). The response warns about plain 'open' faces; prefer 'expanded open' with an internal port (PortOnBound False) on a closed coax/SMA feed.

waveguide_port_faces.description: Optional: faces that carry a waveguide port with structure touching them. A port on a plain 'open' face is reported as an error-level warning.

cst_set_background.name: cst_set_background
cst_set_background.description: Set the background material properties of the simulation domain. The background fills all space not occupied by defined solids.

epsilon.description: Relative permittivity (default 1.0, used when material is Normal)

mu.description: Relative permeability (default 1.0, used when material is Normal)

cst_set_symmetry.name: cst_set_symmetry
cst_set_symmetry.description: Set symmetry planes to reduce computation time. Each axis can be assigned electric or magnetic symmetry, or none. Requires the model geometry and excitation to be compatible with the chosen symmetry.

x_plane.description: Symmetry condition on the YZ plane (default none)

y_plane.description: Symmetry condition on the XZ plane (default none)

z_plane.description: Symmetry condition on the XY plane (default none)

cst_set_frequency_range.name: cst_set_frequency_range
cst_set_frequency_range.description: Set the simulation frequency range in GHz. This determines the bandwidth over which the solver computes results.

cst_set_mesh_type.name: cst_set_mesh_type
cst_set_mesh_type.description: Set the mesh type for the simulation. Hexahedral is used for time-domain, Tetrahedral for frequency-domain, Surface for integral-equation, and Hexahedral TLM for TLM solver.

cst_set_mesh_density.name: cst_set_mesh_density
cst_set_mesh_density.description: Set global mesh density parameters controlling automatic mesh generation. Higher cells_per_wavelength gives finer mesh and better accuracy at the cost of longer simulation time.

cells_per_wavelength.description: Number of mesh cells per wavelength (default 15)

min_cells.description: Minimum number of mesh steps across any structure (default 5)

ratio_limit.description: Maximum ratio between adjacent mesh cells (default 20; hexahedral only)

mesh_type.description: Which MeshSettings map to write: 'Hex' (time domain / hexahedral) or 'Tet' (frequency domain / tetrahedral).

cst_add_mesh_refinement.name: cst_add_mesh_refinement
cst_add_mesh_refinement.description: Add local mesh refinement to a specific solid. This creates finer mesh around critical geometry features like feed points, gaps, or thin layers.

solid.description: Solid name to refine mesh around

refinement_factor.description: Refinement factor — mesh cells are divided by this value (default 2.0)

cst_set_adaptive_mesh.name: cst_set_adaptive_mesh
cst_set_adaptive_mesh.description: Configure time-domain adaptive mesh refinement. When enabled, the solver runs multiple passes, refining the mesh in regions of high field gradient until the result converges within the specified threshold.

enabled.description: Enable or disable adaptive meshing (default true)

max_passes.description: Maximum adaptive refinement passes, at least 2 when enabled (default 3). Not applied when disabled.

threshold.description: Maximum linear magnitude of the complex S-parameter difference between successive passes, from 0 to 1 (default 0.02). Not applied when disabled.

cst_get_mesh_info.name: cst_get_mesh_info
cst_get_mesh_info.description: Get current mesh statistics and settings. In connected mode this queries the live mesh data; in offline mode it returns the VBA to retrieve mesh info.

cst_configure_time_domain_solver.name: cst_configure_time_domain_solver
cst_configure_time_domain_solver.description: Configure the time domain (transient) solver. This is CST's flagship solver for broadband simulations — it excites the structure with a pulse and computes S-parameters, fields, and farfield across the entire frequency range in a single run.

accuracy.description: Steady-state accuracy in dB (Solver.SteadyStateLimit, integer in [-80, 0]) — solver stops when energy has decayed to this level (default -40)

max_time_steps.description: Deprecated/ignored: CST 2026's Solver has no MaxTimeSteps (a note is returned when non-zero). 0 means automatic (default 0)

excitation_type.description: Excitation signal shape (default Gaussian). Only Gaussian (CST's default signal) is applied; other shapes need an excitation-signal definition and return a note.

normalize_to_fixed_impedance.description: Normalize S-parameters to a fixed reference impedance (default true; Solver.AutoNormImpedance True + NormingImpedance). False: port impedance.

fixed_impedance.description: Reference impedance in ohms when normalization is enabled (default 50)

activate_power_loss_1d.description: Enable Solver.ActivatePowerLoss1DMonitor: 1D 'Loss in Dielectrics/Metals' curves. Without it losses exist only at 3D field-monitor frequencies, so the power balance (cst_check_power_balance) cannot be checked at farfield frequencies. Omitted/false leaves the project setting unchanged.

power_loss_1d_use_farfield_monitors.description: UseFarFieldMonitorForPowerLoss1DMonitor (losses at farfield-monitor frequencies; internal full-domain monitors, extra memory).

power_loss_1d_extra_frequencies.description: Extra frequencies (project unit) via UseExtraFreqForPowerLoss1DMonitor + AddPowerLoss1DMonitorExtraFreq.

cst_configure_frequency_domain_solver.name: cst_configure_frequency_domain_solver
cst_configure_frequency_domain_solver.description: Configure the frequency domain solver. Best for narrowband problems, resonant structures, and when field distributions at specific frequencies are needed. Uses CST 2025 SetMethod and sample intervals on a volume mesh. Discrete solves equidistant samples without broadband interpolation. Interpolated uses the tetrahedral fast reduced order model with automatic frequency sampling. General purpose uses automatic frequency sampling on either volume mesh. For both broadband choices, samples caps the automatic solved samples and sets the interpolated output resolution. Monitor frequencies can add solved samples. Sets the global range through Solver.FrequencyRange. No simulation is started.

samples.description: Discrete solved samples, or broadband solved-sample cap and interpolated output count (default 1001)

adaptive_mesh.description: Enable native MeshAdaptionTet or MeshAdaptionHex and mark interval samples for adaptation.

include_monitor_frequencies.description: Calculate monitor frequencies in addition to interval samples (AddMonitorSamples).

normalize_to_fixed_impedance.description: Emit AutoNormImpedance=False when true, with NormingImpedance. Verify actual normalization from exported results.

fixed_impedance.description: NormingImpedance in ohms. The actual result reference must be checked independently.

cst_get_solver_info.name: cst_get_solver_info
cst_get_solver_info.description: Get current solver configuration and status. In connected mode this queries the active solver settings; in offline mode it describes expected parameters.

cst_run_simulation_async.name: cst_run_simulation_async
cst_run_simulation_async.description: Start a CST simulation asynchronously (non-blocking). The simulation launches and control returns immediately. Then call cst_wait_for_simulation (bounded wait, returns within about max_wait_s) repeatedly until it reports status 'finished'; cst_get_simulation_status gives a single instant snapshot.

solver_type.description: Solver type to use. If omitted, the currently configured solver is used. Options: 'Time Domain', 'Frequency Domain', 'Eigenmode', 'Integral Equation'.

timeout_s.description: Maximum CST Python API start-command duration in seconds.

cst_get_simulation_status.name: cst_get_simulation_status
cst_get_simulation_status.description: Read whether a CST simulation is running and return any solver-run metadata exposed by the CST Python API. This does not show a dialog or change the simulation.

outputSchema.description: Solver state. status='ok' always carries running; status='offline' means there is no connected CST project.

cst_wait_for_simulation.name: cst_wait_for_simulation
cst_wait_for_simulation.description: Wait a bounded time for the running CST solve to finish, polling only the read-only 'is solver running' flag about every 2 s. Returns status 'finished' once the solver is idle (confirmed=true when the solve started by cst_run_simulation_async was seen running), 'starting' while a just-launched solve has not begun yet, or 'running' once max_wait_s (default 45, max 55) has passed; for 'running'/'starting' call this tool again. Each CST query's timeout is cut to the remaining budget, so the call returns within about max_wait_s + 2 s. Use after cst_run_simulation_async. Does not start, stop or change the simulation. Requires connected mode.

max_wait_s.description: Maximum seconds to wait in this call (0-55). 0 performs a single status check.

outputSchema.description: status='finished' when the solver is no longer running; status='running' when max_wait_s elapsed first (call cst_wait_for_simulation again); status='starting' when an async solve was launched but CST has not yet reported it running (call again). confirmed=true only when this server started the solve and observed it running before it went idle.

cst_stop_simulation.name: cst_stop_simulation
cst_stop_simulation.description: Stop and abort a running CST simulation. Unlike pause, a stopped simulation cannot be resumed — it must be restarted from the beginning.

cst_add_field_monitor.name: cst_add_field_monitor
cst_add_field_monitor.description: Add a field monitor at a specific frequency to the CST project. Field monitors must be defined before running a simulation to capture field distributions, far-field patterns, surface currents, or power flow at the desired frequency. CST 2026 has no 'Surfacecurrent' FieldType (it is silently ignored): requests for surface current are mapped to an 'Hfield' monitor, which yields '2D/3D Results\H-Field\...' and '2D/3D Results\Surface Current\surface current (f=X) [1]'. The response lists the expected result tree items. Note: 1D power-loss curves (Loss in Dielectrics/Metals) are only computed at field-monitor frequencies unless cst_configure_time_domain_solver activate_power_loss_1d=true.

monitor_type.description: CST Monitor.FieldType: Efield, Hfield, Powerflow, Current, Powerloss, Eenergy, Henergy, Farfield, Fieldsource, Spacecharge, Particlecurrentdensity. Hfield also gives the surface current. Aliases such as 'surface current'/'Surfacecurrent' are translated to Hfield; anything else undocumented is rejected.

name.description: Custom name for the monitor. If omitted, a name is auto-generated from the type and frequency, e.g. 'e-field (f=2.45)'.

cst_import_cad.name: cst_import_cad
cst_import_cad.description: Import a CAD file into CST Studio. Supports STEP (.stp/.step), IGES (.igs/.iges), STL (.stl), SAT/ACIS (.sat), DXF (.dxf), and OBJ (.obj) formats.

file_path.description: Full path to the CAD file to import.

format.description: CAD file format: stp (STEP), igs (IGES), stl, sat (ACIS), dxf, obj.

component.description: Target component name for the imported geometry.

cst_export_cad.name: cst_export_cad
cst_export_cad.description: Export the current CST model (or a specific component) to a CAD format. Supports STL, SAT/ACIS, STEP, IGES, OBJ, and NASTRAN.

file_path.description: Destination file path for the exported CAD file.

format.description: Export format: stl, sat, stp (STEP), igs (IGES), obj, nas (NASTRAN).

component.description: Optional component name to export. If omitted, the entire model is exported.

cst_set_parameter.name: cst_set_parameter
cst_set_parameter.description: Set or create a design parameter in CST Studio. Parameters can hold numeric values or string expressions referencing other parameters. The value is stored through the parameter list (never as a model-history step) and the model is rebuilt. A parameter change invalidates results: on a solved project pass delete_results=true (results are deleted first), otherwise the call is refused with code results_exist.

value.description: Parameter value — a number (e.g. 10.5) or a string expression referencing other parameters (e.g. 'patch_length / 2').

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the parameter.

rebuild.description: Rebuild the model after storing the value (default true).

delete_results.description: Required when the project already has simulation results: they are deleted first (export anything you need). Without it the call is refused with code results_exist, because CST would block on a modal dialog.

cst_get_parameter.name: cst_get_parameter
cst_get_parameter.description: Get the current value of a design parameter. Returns both the stored expression and the evaluated numeric value.

name.description: Name of the parameter to retrieve.

cst_list_parameters.name: cst_list_parameters
cst_list_parameters.description: List all design parameters in the current CST project with their names, expressions, and evaluated numeric values.

cst_delete_results.name: cst_delete_results
cst_delete_results.description: Delete simulation results from the current CST project. This prevents the 'Results May Get Incompatible With Model' dialog that blocks automation when modifying a model with existing results. Call before making parameter or geometry changes on a project that has been solved.

cst_read_project_log.name: cst_read_project_log
cst_read_project_log.description: Read solver log files and project status information from the current CST project. Returns solver running state and the contents of the most recent log file. Useful for diagnosing solver errors, checking simulation progress, and understanding what happened during a failed run.

cst_dismiss_dialogs.name: cst_dismiss_dialogs
cst_dismiss_dialogs.description: Find and dismiss any visible CST dialog windows (error popups, 'Results Incompatible' dialogs, solver warnings). Returns the title and text content of each dialog before dismissing it. Use this to unblock CST when a modal dialog is preventing further automation. Uses Win32 API on Windows.

read_only.description: If true, only read dialog content without dismissing. Default: false (read and dismiss).

cst_start_dialog_watcher.name: cst_start_dialog_watcher
cst_start_dialog_watcher.description: Start a background thread that automatically detects and dismisses CST dialog windows as they appear. Essential for long-running operations like optimization loops where dialogs would otherwise block execution. The watcher logs every dialog it dismisses — retrieve the log with cst_stop_dialog_watcher.

cst_stop_dialog_watcher.name: cst_stop_dialog_watcher
cst_stop_dialog_watcher.description: Stop the background dialog watcher and return its log of all dialogs that were auto-dismissed. Use after completing an operation that required the watcher.

cst_check_model_setup.name: cst_check_model_setup
cst_check_model_setup.description: Read-only sanity check of a described setup (nothing is sent to CST). Warns when a waveguide port sits on an 'open' (no added space) boundary face and the structure touches that face: CST extends geometry touching an open boundary into the PML (virtually infinite), so power is absorbed there, the balance P_acc = P_rad + P_loss does not close and efficiency/gain are unreliable. Also flags plain 'open' faces the structure reaches, PortOnBound True on faces with added space, and farfield frequencies without loss data (ActivatePowerLoss1DMonitor off).

boundaries.description: Face -> boundary type, e.g. {'y_min': 'open', 'x_min': 'expanded open'} (keys x_min..z_max or xmin..zmax).

plane.description: Port plane coordinate along its normal axis.

structure_bbox.description: Structure bounding box {xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax, zmin, zmax} (model units).

cst_add_sma_edge_connector.name: cst_add_sma_edge_connector
cst_add_sma_edge_connector.description: Add a parametric edge-launch SMA connector at a board edge: PEC body (default 9.5 x 9.5 x 6 mm) standing off the edge by 'gap', PTFE coax (er 2.1, pin radius 0.635, outer radius 2.1 mm = 49.5 ohm; or target_impedance), pin overlapping the signal strip with a solder block, PEC legs bonded to the CPW grounds (or a bottom leg on a microstrip ground), and an internal waveguide port on the coax back face (PortOnBound False). This closed feed avoids a port on an 'open' boundary, where CST extends the board into the PML and the power balance/gain break; use it with ALL boundaries 'expanded open'. Mirrors a model verified in CST 2026 (balance closed within 0.6 %). copper_z_convention is required: pin/legs start at the copper TOP face, and a wrong convention leaves a 35 um air gap that the mesh resolves as an open circuit.

edge.description: Board edge the connector sits on; the port orientation equals it.

edge_position.description: Coordinate of that board edge (y for ymin/ymax, x for xmin/xmax).

feed_center.description: Signal-strip centre along the edge (x for y-edges, y for x-edges).

substrate_top_z.description: z of the substrate top face.

copper_z_convention.description: 'copper_below_top': copper at substrate_top_z - t .. substrate_top_z (what a raw clockwise Polygon + ExtrudeCurve with positive thickness gives). 'copper_above_top': substrate_top_z .. +t (cst_create_polygon_extrude, extrude_direction 'up').

ground_type.description: cpw: two top legs on the coplanar grounds; microstrip: one leg under the board on the back-side ground.

outer_radius.description: Coax dielectric outer radius (2.1 mm -> 49.5 ohm with er 2.1).

target_impedance.description: If set, outer_radius is computed for this Z0 (ohm).

body_half.description: Half of the square body cross-section.

gap.description: Air gap between board edge and body front face.

pin_overlap.description: Pin length over the signal strip (from the board edge).

leg_inner.description: Leg inner offset from the feed centre (on the grounds).

leg_on_board.description: How far the legs extend onto the board from the edge.

cst_export_structure_views.name: cst_export_structure_views
cst_export_structure_views.description: Export structure screenshots (perspective/xy/xz/yz) via Plot.ExportImage. Yapı görünüm görsellerini dışa aktarır. Connected mode required.

views.description: Subset of: perspective, xy, xz, yz
